notes.title: Minor patch to fix Steam Deck compatibility
notes.content:
We just updated the game to fix some issues that were preventing the game from working correctly on Steam Deck.
Desktop version is unchanged.

tags.bug: We just updated the game to fix some issues that were preventing the game from working correctly on Steam Deck.

notes.title: ToA: An Elven Marriage version 1.0.6
notes.content:
[b]What's New in 1.0.6[/b]

- by mistake swapped Loren with Karen sprite in the ending if you choose to remain loyal to her
- if you tried to use Rei's Debilitating Strike skill without him having any melee weapons the game would crash. Now it works, albeit you'll do trivial damage

notes.title: ToA: An Elven Marriage version 1.0.5
notes.content:
[b]What's New in 1.0.5[/b]

- fixed an issue that would prevent getting past the level up screen if you went past level 34 (all skills learned, but still skill points awarded). Now you can still level up to 45 (level cap), but obviously you can't assign any more skill points past level 35 since all slots are full.

tags.bug: - fixed an issue that would prevent getting past the level up screen if you went past level 34 (all skills learned, but still skill points awarded).
